title: Billable Repair Hours and Repair Documentation on the Security Deposit Account
content:
**Standard.** The billable hours of a damage repair charge on a Security Deposit Account follow when and how the repair was documented:

1. A repair line itemized **more than 14 calendar days** after the move-out date, **with** dated photos on file, is billed for its recorded hours rounded down to a whole hour.
2. A repair line itemized **more than 14 calendar days** after the move-out date, **without** dated photos, is billed for its recorded hours, but never more than 2.0 hours.
3. A repair line itemized **within 14 calendar days** of the move-out date is billed for its recorded hours.

The billable hours are the hours that are multiplied by the labor rate.

**Records read.** From the damage repair line: its itemization date, its recorded labor hours and whether dated inspection photos are on file. From the deposit account: the move-out date.

## Decision table

| Days from move-out to itemization | Dated photos on file | Billable hours |
|---|---|---|
| 15 or more | yes | recorded hours, rounded down to a whole hour |
| 15 or more | no | recorded hours, at most 2.0 |
| 14 or fewer | either | recorded hours |

## Boundary and worked cases (hypothetical, move-out 1 June)

| Itemized on | Days after move-out | Photos | Recorded hours | Billable hours |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 June | 14 | no | 3.5 | 3.5 |
| 16 June | 15 | yes | 3.5 | 3 |
| 16 June | 15 | no | 3.5 | 2.0 |
| 20 June | 19 | no | 1.5 | 1.5 |
| 20 June | 19 | yes | 0.5 | 0 |
